packet.task_text: Coordinate the intake, processing, and reporting teams around a revised handoff for a research dashboard.
Define the contract between a local scheduler and its worker so their new handoff is unambiguous.
Plan how data operations, interface work, and release notes should stay aligned during a service split.
Map the boundary between a queue consumer and a storage adapter before changing their message format.
Coordinate a shared rollout spanning the command line tool, background process, and documentation site.
Clarify ownership at the boundary where a webhook receiver passes records to a normalization service.
Set the scope, acceptance checks, and approval boundary for a small data-import repair.
Order the migration steps and name the condition that should stop the work before deployment.
Write a concise agreement for what counts as complete in a documentation correction.
Identify which prerequisite must finish first and when the automation must pause.
Define authorized changes, acceptance evidence, dependencies, and stop conditions for the parser update.
Sequence the release checklist and specify the failure signal that blocks the next step.
Choose evidence that demonstrates the new cache behavior works under the intended request flow.
Decide whether the current test oracle is adequate for the serialization edge cases.
Design the checks and evidence needed before asserting that a retry change preserves behavior.
Evaluate whether a snapshot comparison can distinguish the regression from expected output.
Select a verification approach for a concurrency fix whose behavior is visible only under load.
Decide which observable signal makes a browser smoke check trustworthy for this form submission.
Analyze recurring import failures to decide which mechanism is responsible and how the workflow should adapt.
Decide when a maintained evaluation note should be refreshed or retired after a policy change.
Turn repeated review findings into an updated evaluation rule with a clear freshness boundary.
Determine why the repair loop keeps misclassifying failures and what adaptation should follow.
Set a lifecycle for experimental notes so superseded observations do not guide later decisions.
Compare competing causes for a flaky job and decide how its feedback loop should change.
Rename one local variable in a self-contained utility; the requested edit and check are already fixed.
Apply a supplied spelling correction in one markdown file with no dependent components.
Format a single configuration entry exactly as specified; the task is self-contained and no feedback or adaptation decision remains.
Update one comment to match an already approved API name; no new decision is needed.
Coordinate the API and worker rollout, then establish the authorized scope and acceptance criteria for the change.
Choose evidence for a latency fix and determine how repeated failures should change the remediation loop.
Coordinate parsing and formatting concerns inside one self-contained local utility where native execution remains sufficient.
Set the acceptance boundary for the patch, but it is not yet known whether an upstream approval step is required.
Use $agentic-engineering to coordinate the interface, service, and worker handoff.
Use $codex-task-contract to define the authorized scope and acceptance criteria.
Before accepting the cache change, have $verification-strategy-engineering define the evidence needed to support its behavior claim.
Use $engineering-learning-loop to decide how recurring failures should update the feedback process.
